request_text: I accompanied the State Auditor (an elected official) to the Western States Audit Forum and stayed at the forum hotel, the Lakeshore Grand, in the $520 room next to hers. The hotel's rate sheet is attached and $520 was its lowest advertised rate that week. I was not required to attend the forum myself, I was there as her staff. The deputy approved the lodging exception on September 25. Please pay the full $520.
